facts.text: FlowBoard — project boards for small agencies
FlowBoard gives small agencies client-ready project boards with approvals in one place. Plans start at $12 per user per month, with a free plan for up to 3 boards.
FlowBoard integrates with Slack and Google Drive, and every workspace is covered by SOC 2 Type II audited security.
More than 2,000 agency teams use FlowBoard to run client approvals without scattered email threads.

pains.text: Approvals and follow-ups live in scattered threads, so leads go cold.
Client content production eats billable hours every week.
